content: Bobo’otis Wine Masauai Sibobo
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Safam an Baiaiwab on atonio nanaba. Ra tani orot masau matuanin on fomenei igat inai sabu fani iyawures sitnat wine masauai sitabo mes.
Orot ibasit ato ra kaitamom an agim fofonin on bobo’otis itibaiyanis, ato on sabu iyawures sinai an wine masau on sitabo mes.
Fomenei wera nimtereban baibatin nanaba on orot igat men inai baitotobon efanai nan ato on iyeit Sabu asi bobo ambin fetag nan sitatawar ites,
on mes iyawures iyau, ‘Omi mat wonan wine masauai wonabo, ato yau arimon ami baiyan fofonin anitem.’
On mes osi sabu sinai. Namon wera aiyet nanaba masau matuanin on bobo kaitamom nanaba ifour a rabirabi wera ton nanaba on bobo kaitamom ifour men.

Rabirabi wera kafakakai mom nim itboai ato masau matuanin igat inai baitotobon efanai ato on iyeit sabu fani ba nan sitatawar ites. On itetemis iyau, ‘Omi aibo mes ami wera wobisawarai ami bobo ambin nin wotatawar mom wera inai esusur?’
Sabu on siyafotai siyau, “Wei men iyafan tani bobo itei wanabo on. On iyawures iyau, ‘Basit omi wonan wine masauai nan bobo wonabo.’

Wera inai ibirabirabi, masau matuanin on an orot gagamin, on masau bobo’otis ikakaifares on iyawur iyau, ‘Bobo’otis eyores ato asi baiyan unites; sabu iyabon gibui babag awures sibobo on nan unbosuruf unan ato osi iyabon ainau awures sibobo on nan unisawarai.’
Sabu iyabon rabirabi wera nim nanaba bobo sibosuruf sibobo on agim kaitamom on sabu kakaita kakaita iraramis.
Ato sabu iyabon ainau iyawures sibobo on sinat sitibaiyanis mes, osi sinos on agim gagamin sitboai; baise osi mat on agim kaitamom on ites.
Osi agim sibo ato sibosuruf masau matuanin aurin on sigam sibikakafun.

Osi siyau, ‘Atonio osi sabu gibui bag uyawures on wera kaitamom wat on siboen, ato wei on fomenei bobo wabosuruf wera forabinai wabobo mom inai irabirabi—baise om osi ubibaiyanis fofonin on wei mat nanaba ubaiyani!’
Masau matuanin on osi orot tani aurin iyafotai iyau, ‘Turau untatam, yau men bobo komasin tani aurim afour on. Omi on woibasitai ra kaitamom wonabo agim kaitamom wonboai aurin on.
Omi ami agim woboen ato wonai au go. Yau agogoi atonio orot gibui bag awur ibobo on an baiyan anitai mamaba om abitem ba.
Yau au baibad yen tou au gogoi nanaba au agim aurin anafour. O om ebiboboar yabin yau au obin atonio osi sabu auris afofour on mes i?’”
Ato Iesu an dura kanfounai iyau, “On mes sabu iyabon gibui senat on arimon sininau, ato osi sabu iyabon ainau senan on arimon sinnat sinigib.”
Iesu Inrarabob aurin Wera Baitonin Ba Ikakafun
Iesu on igeg au Jerusalem ato osi nana sibib si’nan, Iesu on an baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam iboes sinai mabisi nan dura bubuniai ikasones.
On iyawures iyau, “Omi wontatam, ot tageg au Jerusalem nan Orot Natun min arimon sinboai priest aiwabis a Baifafaro an baibebeotis imasi sinyagai. Osi arimon sinimakiai inarab
ato sabu men Jew yangan on imasi sinyagai, osi arimon sinikoboai, sinaswabirai a nabai sinkubarai; baise ra ton on God arimon rabob emon inbobaimisirai inyawas.”
Ayos an Baifefeyan
Namon Zebedee awan on nanatun ruam mat sinat Iesu aurin, nanai nan sindas sirou, ato Iesu sifefeyanai bobo tani itafour weines mes.
Iesu on jever itetemai iyau, “Om aifan egogoi?” Jever iyafotai iyau, “Om unaumataniu, unbiAiwab an rai on nanatu ruam on tani am asumaiauai a tani on am asugagafai sinamair.”

Iesu on nanatun ruam iyafotes iyau, “Omi men wosagob aifan aurin on wobifefeyan. Yau on baikokosar an viga toman mes abiyam on omi fofonim baikokosar an viga wontoman i?” Osi siyafotai siyau, “Wei fofoni.”

Iesu iyawures iyau, “Omi on dura bag Yau au viga emon wontoman, baise Yau au baibad men yen on anrubinem iyafan on au asumaiauai a au asugagafai wonamair. Atonio efan on Tamau ibotitiwag osi sabu iyabon On irurubinis on ininoanis mes.”
Baigibubunuotis auyotoat fani on dura sitatam on yas sitatab ainau giya rus auris.
On mes Iesu iyores engon siruayo ato iyau, “Omi wosagob eteni sabu bainetewarotis yangan on asi faiwar on osi sabu auris yen, ato bainetewarotis on asi baibad tutufin sebotan.
Baise omi sanamui on men on bobo nanaba inen mes. Omi iyafan egogoi inigagamin on sabu engon tutufin auris iniagir;
ato omi sanamui orot tani iyafan egogoi ininau on, omi ami agirotin inmatar—
Orot Natun ba, On men inat sabu sinmisir On siniagirai mes on, baise On inat sabu iniagires a an yawas inkutetai sabu sigaraba intobonis men mes.”
Iesu Orot Ruam Matas Fotis Iyawasis
Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat Jericho mafam gagamin sibikirir ato sabu kuayo gagamin on osi sibigibubunues.
Orot matas fotis ruam on etai simair simama ato sitatam Iesu inat ikirires i’nan, on mes osi sibosuruf sibiyoku si’yau, “Bada, David Natun ekaberei!”
Sabu kuayo on simisir sigam siyawures ato siyawures awas sitafot mes. Baise osi aumiet bag siyoku, “Bada, David Natun ekaberei!”
Iesu itawar ato auris iyor. On itetemis iyau, “Omi ami gogoi on aifan anafour weinem i?”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Bada, wei wagogoi Om matai uniyamai waneit!”
Iesu on osi auris iyababan ato matas iruyeinen; ra kaita osi matas siyeit sawar siten, ato osi On sigibubunuai.
